description: A fun filled space exploring session is guaranteed.
summary: MissionForge is an interactive Space Mission Design Game that lets anyone design, launch and simulate a complete space mission. Players choose a mission goal, then build a spacecraft by selecting instruments, power system, antenna, orbit, launch vehicle and mission lifetime. A live dashboard shows mass, power, budget and data limits, so every choice has a visible consequence. A simulation with random events produces a mission report that explains why the mission succeeded or failed, and a score rewards efficient engineering. Solo and team modes (up to four players with roles) are supported. It addresses the challenge by turning real systems engineering trade-offs into hands-on learning for beginners. It matters because few students ever experience how mission decisions affect each other.
details:
• What it does: Players design a mission in four steps (payload, power and communications, orbit and launch, lifetime), then simulate it. The game checks that the spacecraft mass fits the rocket for the chosen orbit, that power covers all systems, that data fits the antenna, that the cost fits the budget, and that the orbit matches the goal.
  • Benefits: It teaches why decisions matter and that many different designs can succeed. It needs no advanced knowledge.
  • Intended impact: To make mission design accessible to students and future engineers.
  • Tools: HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one web page. Slides made as PowerPoint.
  • Creativity: Random events, team roles, and a post-mission explanation of failures.
  • Factors considered: Mass, power, budget, data, communications, orbit and lifetime, with simplified numbers for learning.
